rationale: Stage 1 (s1) resets on rst_n, while stage 2 (s2, line 8) resets on unconstrained primary input mode_i, so the synchroniser stages have different async reset roots. An Icarus witness with mode_i held low shows s1=1 while s2=0. Releasing mode_i asynchronously therefore presents D != Q at s2, which can go metastable and feed data_o_r directly. CDC-026 diagnoses it, and CDC-041 (source/output-stage reset roots differ) also applies. The class is synchronizer_structure ('inconsistent clock or reset'), as both readers concluded. RDC-005/003 would apply under --goal rdc but are disabled under --goal cdc, so they are not pinned. Raw rst_n release, recovery/removal and physical timing remain external obligations outside this label.
